description: Book a haircut in Poland from the terminal — search barbers, compare prices and reviews, check open slots, and book, with a dry-run-by-default booking guard.

tools.name: businesses_get
tools.description: Full business profile: services (with prices/variant ids), staff, hours, reviews summary. Required: business_id. Optional: with-combos (default: 1), with-markdown (default: 0). Returns the BusinessDetailEnvelope.

tools.name: businesses_reviews
tools.description: Customer reviews for a business. Required: business_id. Optional: page (default: 1), per-page (default: 20), ordering. Returns array of Review.

tools.name: businesses_search
tools.description: Search barbers/salons. Filter by query, city (location-id), and category; sort by score/distance/reviews. Optional: query, location-id, location-geo (plus 7 more). Returns array of BusinessListItem.

params.name: location-geo
params.description: lat,lng geo string as an alternative to location-id

params.name: online-only
params.description: 1 to only include businesses with online booking

tools.name: discover_locations
tools.description: Resolve a place/city name to Booksy location ids for search. Optional: query, advanced. Returns array of LocationHint.

tools.name: discover_suggest
tools.description: Query suggestions (treatments/categories) for free text. Optional: text, location-id, location-geo. Returns array of Suggestion.

params.name: location-id
params.description: Bias suggestions to a city/area id

tools.name: discover_treatments
tools.description: Popular treatments to browse/seed a search. Optional: limit (default: 20). Returns array of Treatment.

tools.name: me_home
tools.description: Your Booksy home: active booking box, favorite/visited businesses, categories. Requires auth. Optional: no-thumbs (default: true). Returns the MyBooksy.

tools.name: me_profile
tools.description: Your customer profile (name, email, phone). Requires auth. Returns the Customer.

novel_features.name: Guided haircut booking
novel_features.description: Book an appointment end to end — it previews the exact service, staffer, time, and price first, and only sends the real booking when you pass --confirm.

novel_features.name: Open slots
novel_features.description: List open time slots for a service at a business over a date range, grouped by day. No login required.

novel_features.name: Services table
novel_features.description: Flatten a business profile into a clean table of bookable services with price, duration, and the service-variant id you pass to book.

novel_features.name: Soonest slot
novel_features.description: Find the single earliest open slot for a service across a date window in one call.

novel_features.name: Compare barbers
novel_features.description: Compare several businesses side by side on rating, review count, and cheapest matching service price — from the local cache.

novel_features.name: Cheapest haircut nearby
novel_features.description: Scan search results in a city and rank businesses by the cheapest service matching your query (e.g. haircut), with rating alongside price.
